scope: Complete kernel-only exact-Real correctness and native BF16 word equality under one fixed instruction model.
raw_input_words: BitVec32 identity leaves through one shared physical reader
output_words: BitVec16 BF16; observation zero-extends output only and preserves original FP32 exterior words
visible_structure: 16 K8 QK zero-seeded steps over padded D128
four K16 PV zero-seeded steps over BN64 with FP16 output
16 ordered local values and xor2 then xor1 reduction
all live online blocks and tails
FP32 widening, online FMA and division
model_boundaries: Truthful ordinary Tensor API shape, layout, dtype, device, indexing, capacity and data-pointer observations; fresh output allocation.
Stable input memory; read aliases use one physical reader.
One fixed scalar/conversion/fixed-ISA interpretation for every source operation and every input word.

Compiler/source/ISA interpretation and applicability, CUDA driver and resource availability are external runtime conditions. The finite offline artifacts are evidence, not a universal compiler theorem.
historical_transport: Original conditional LocalTransport theorems are retained, but the current public one-model kernel theorem does not use them.
